items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Lewis has just taken the place of Jim Lipsman's band there.

ctx.x: Well, the Red Garter. Yeah, I heard the stuff there. I've been there when I went to the Sunday afternoon. And I was calling for girls to play. And now when yours, Lewis.
George Lewis has just taken the place of Jim Lipsman's band there.
Yeah, the Clannotella was fired from then. That's why the whole band left.
